# Roles

Roles of contract v1, by `theme.json` group. Contrast (the last two columns: the role as foreground on those surfaces, and the foregrounds checked on the role) is checked per mode by `npm run theme:check` (WCAG 2 AA; text 4.5:1, controls and focus 3:1); an optional role a theme omits is checked with its core default. Guide: [../creating-a-theme.md](../creating-a-theme.md).

## `color`

Color roles. A `value` is one string or one value per mode id; contrast is checked in every mode.

| Role | Required | Purpose | As text or control on | As background for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `surface` | required | Page background. | none | `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent`, `link`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `category-1`, `category-2`, `category-3`, `category-4`, `category-5` ≥ 4.5:1; `line-strong`, `focus` ≥ 3:1 |
| `surface-raised` | required | Cards, menus, form fields and the mobile tab bar. | none | `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent`, `link`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `category-1`, `category-2`, `category-3`, `category-4`, `category-5` ≥ 4.5:1; `line-strong`, `focus` ≥ 3:1 |
| `surface-sunken` | required | Code blocks and inset areas such as figures and card covers. | none | `ink`, `ink-muted`, `accent`, `link`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`, `category-1`, `category-2`, `category-3`, `category-4`, `category-5`, `code-ink`, `code-muted`, `code-keyword`, `code-string`, `code-number`, `code-function` ≥ 4.5:1; `line-strong`, `focus` ≥ 3:1 |
| `line` | required | Decorative hairlines: separators and card borders. | none | none |
| `line-strong` | required | Control borders (inputs, secondary button). | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` ≥ 3:1 | none |
| `ink` | required | Main text and the fill of the primary button. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | `on-ink` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `ink-muted` | required | Secondary text: excerpts, metadata, dates, help. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `on-ink` | required | Text on an `ink` fill. | `ink` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `accent` | required | Brand accent: the accent button, active states, brand marks. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `accent-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | `on-accent` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `accent-soft` | required | Tinted background behind accent text. | none | `accent` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `accent-hover` | required | The accent on hover. | none | `on-accent` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `on-accent` | required | Text and icons on the accent. | `accent`, `accent-hover` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `link` | required | Links in running text. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `link-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `focus` | required | Focus ring. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` ≥ 3:1 | none |
| `success` | required | Success state. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `success-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `success-soft` | required | Background of a success message. | none | `success` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `warning` | required | Warning state. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `warning-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `warning-soft` | required | Background of a warning message. | none | `warning` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `danger` | required | Errors and destructive actions. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `danger-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `danger-soft` | required | Background of an error message. | none | `danger` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `info` | required | Informative state. | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `info-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `info-soft` | required | Background of an informative message. | none | `info` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `category-1` | required | Color of category 1: categories take the roles in order (`categoryColor()`). | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `category-1-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `category-1-soft` | required | Tinted background behind category 1 text. | none | `category-1` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `category-2` | required | Color of category 2: categories take the roles in order (`categoryColor()`). | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `category-2-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `category-2-soft` | required | Tinted background behind category 2 text. | none | `category-2` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `category-3` | required | Color of category 3: categories take the roles in order (`categoryColor()`). | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `category-3-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `category-3-soft` | required | Tinted background behind category 3 text. | none | `category-3` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `category-4` | required | Color of category 4: categories take the roles in order (`categoryColor()`). | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `category-4-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `category-4-soft` | required | Tinted background behind category 4 text. | none | `category-4` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `category-5` | required | Color of category 5: categories take the roles in order (`categoryColor()`). | `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken`, `category-5-soft` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `category-5-soft` | required | Tinted background behind category 5 text. | none | `category-5` ≥ 4.5:1 |
| `code-ink` | required | Code text. | `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `code-muted` | required | Comments and punctuation in code. | `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `code-keyword` | required | Keywords in code. | `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `code-string` | required | Strings in code. | `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `code-number` | required | Numbers in code. | `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `code-function` | required | Function names in code. | `surface-sunken` ≥ 4.5:1 | none |
| `link-soft` | optional, core default `color-mix(in srgb, var(--link) 12%, var(--surface))` | Tinted background for links, highlights and active items. | none | `link` ≥ 4.5:1 |

## `shadow`

Shadow and glow roles. A `value` may be `none`, and may be one string or one value per mode id.

| Role | Required | Purpose | As text or control on | As background for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-raised` | required | Shadow of a raised card (CTA and pricing sections). | none | none |
| `shadow-overlay` | required | Shadow of the slider arrow buttons. | none | none |
| `glow-accent` | required | Glow of the accent button on hover (`bd-btn-accent`); may be `none`. | none | none |
| `glow-link` | optional, core default `none` | Glow on focused and hovered interactive surfaces. | none | none |

## `spacing`

Space scale and page rhythm. `at` gives responsive values.

| Role | Required | Purpose | As text or control on | As background for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `space-1` | required | Step 1 of the space scale. | none | none |
| `space-2` | required | Step 2 of the space scale. | none | none |
| `space-3` | required | Step 3 of the space scale. | none | none |
| `space-4` | required | Step 4 of the space scale. | none | none |
| `space-6` | required | Step 6 of the space scale. | none | none |
| `space-8` | required | Step 8 of the space scale. | none | none |
| `space-12` | required | Step 12 of the space scale. | none | none |
| `space-section` | required | Padding between page sections. | none | none |
| `space-gutter` | required | Gap of card grids. | none | none |
| `space-inline` | required | Side margin of the page, per breakpoint. | none | none |

## `radius`

Corner radii.

| Role | Required | Purpose | As text or control on | As background for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `radius-control` | required | Corners of buttons, fields and chips. | none | none |
| `radius-card` | required | Corners of article cards (`bd-card`). | none | none |
| `radius-full` | required | Fully rounded corners: avatars and the account menu button. | none | none |

## `size`

Widths and heights of the page.

| Role | Required | Purpose | As text or control on | As background for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `container` | required | Maximum width of the page content. The core does not read it directly; reference it from other values with `{container}`, for example in `space-inline`. | none | none |
| `measure` | required | Maximum width of text columns: the about page sections and the `centered` article. | none | none |
| `nav-height` | required | Height of the header's main row in the `bar` layout, from 768px. | none | none |

## `motion`

Durations and easing curves.

| Role | Required | Purpose | As text or control on | As background for |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration-fast` | required | Entrance of the search palette. | none | none |
| `duration-base` | required | Hover, focus and color transitions. | none | none |
| `duration-slow` | required | Slow transitions, such as font stretch. | none | none |
| `ease-standard` | required | Default easing curve. | none | none |
| `ease-emphasized` | required | Easing of the slider and the back-to-top button. | none | none |

## `type`

Font families (`type.families`, all required): `display`, `sans`, `mono`. Each generates `--font-<family>`.

The scale needs every step below, in `type.groups`; a group's `family` must be one of the families.

| Step | Font shorthand (weight, size, line height, family) | Letter spacing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `--text-display-xl` | `--tracking-display-xl` |
| `display-l` | `--text-display-l` | `--tracking-display-l` |
| `heading-1` | `--text-heading-1` | `--tracking-heading-1` |
| `heading-2` | `--text-heading-2` | `--tracking-heading-2` |
| `heading-3` | `--text-heading-3` | `--tracking-heading-3` |
| `body-l` | `--text-body-l` | `--tracking-body-l` |
| `body` | `--text-body` | `--tracking-body` |
| `body-s` | `--text-body-s` | `--tracking-body-s` |
| `eyebrow` | `--text-eyebrow` | `--tracking-eyebrow` |
| `meta` | `--text-meta` | `--tracking-meta` |
| `code` | `--text-code` | `--tracking-code` |
